PixCull 默认有 14 类内置题材识别 — 但 <b>婚纱</b> /\n:
PixCull recognises 14 built-in genres by default, but wedding / birding / children / landscape and other business verticals score very differently.

This page lets you upload a reference batch for each of the 10 verticals (👍 good / 👎 cull). Once PixCull has learned them, your next batch of that kind is scored with your taste, not a generic template.
每个垂类卡有 3 个工具:<br><br>\n <b>🎯 调参:
Each vertical card has three tools:

🎯 Tune · grid-search the best keep/cull thresholds on your good and bad samples, with the F1 gain shown live
✨ AI phrases · DeepSeek writes dedicated notes from your samples instead of generic lines like "subject covers 30%"
📊 Report · confusion matrix and misclassified samples for the current policy on your samples
